WRGP
WRGP allows master’s, graduate certificate, and doctoral students who are residents of any of the participating WICHE states (Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oregon, South Dakota, Utah, Washington, Wyoming and the U.S. Pacific Territories and Freely Associated States) the opportunity to pay a reduced tuition rate which is currently equal to in-state tuition. Not every UCCS graduate program participates in WRGP; see below for participating programs.
There is nothing you need to do to claim this award except verify that your permanent address on your graduate school application reflects your residency in a qualifying state. The benefit is automatically applied to your tuition bill, and you are qualified to receive it throughout the duration of your graduate education at UCCS, pending your enrollment in a qualifying program and your continued legal residency in your current state.

Applying as a Non-Degree Seeking Student
Non-Degree Seeking/Unclassified Applicants
Non-Degree Seeking/Unclassified Applicants
Applicants who hold a bachelors/baccalaureate degree and do not wish to pursue an advanced degree (masters, doctoral, graduate certificate or course of study program), and only wish to take a class(es), should apply to UCCS as a non-degree seeking graduate student.
To start your application, please start here: Start your application here!
Select Graduate and then term you are wishing to start taking courses. To start the application, click the gold button.
Once on the Graduate Application, you will select Non-Degree on the Enrollment Information section by selecting the following:
What level of degree/certificate are you applying to? : Non-Degree Graduate or Course of Study Certificate
In which type of degree program do you plan to enroll? : On Campus (Please note: This will not limit you to taking courses in-person. You may select to enroll in an online course if desired.)
Primary On Campus Degree/Major: Non-Degree Graduate (not seeking a certificate or degree)
Application requirements of non-degree graduate applications are:
Online Graduate Application
$60 application fee
Please note: Transcripts are not required to complete your application, however, applicants will be required to show proof of pre-requisite completion prior to being able to enroll in graduate level courses. You can review current course offerings and prerequisite requirements using this link: https://registrar.uccs.edu/cic
Applicants may submit unofficial or official transcripts. Applicants can upload their copy/copies of transcripts in the education history section of the application or admissions portal after submitting their application. Even after an admission decision is made, applicants can upload transcripts in their admissions portal by clicking on the Applicant section within their portal or you may email/send them electronically to ugapp@uccs.edu .
Students participating in Continuing Education & Professional Development should reach out to Outreach Programs at outreach@uccs.edu for more information on opportunities and courses offered through UCCS. You can also view more information on our Outreach Programs page.

Application Fee Waivers
UCCS offers three application fee waiver options.
Scholar Program Application Fee Waivers:
If you were involved in one or more of the following scholar programs, you may be eligible for an application fee waiver:
Extended Studies agreement EdAssist
Fullbright Scholar Program
Gate Millennium Scholars Program
GEM: National Consortium for Graduate Degrees for Minorities in Engineering and Science Program
Maximizing Access to Reach Careers (MARC) Program
Research Initiative for Scientific Enhancement (RISE) Program
The McNair Scholars Program
Trio Support Student Services (SSS) Program
Undergraduate Student Training in Academic Research (U-Star) Program
How to utilize this waiver:
Within your graduate school application, upload a letter from your program coordinator where you participated in one of the above programs. Please be sure the letter includes your full name and the program you are applying to at UCCS OR
Ask your program coordinator to send their verification letter directly to us at gograd@uccs.edu
Financial Need Based Application Fee Waivers:
To qualify for a financial need application fee waiver, you must fall into one of the following categories:
College Seniors:
A dependent, who has FAFSA Submission Summary that shows a parental contribution of not more than $2,500 for the senior year (submit a copy of the FAFSA Submission Summary) OR
Self-supporting and have a FAFSA Submission Summary that shows a contribution of not more than $3,000 for the senior year (submit a copy of the FAFSA Submission Summary) OR
If you received a fee reduction voucher from ETS to take the GRE test, you qualify for an application fee waiver. Please send us a copy of the fee reduction voucher you received from ETS for the GRE test.
Unenrolled College Graduates:
Have applied for financial aid, AND
Have a FAFSA Submission Summary that indicates self-supporting status and a contribution of not more than $3,000 (submit a copy of the FAFSA Submission Summary) OR
Fee Reduction Voucher:
If you received a fee reduction voucher from ETS to take the GRE test, you qualify for an application fee waiver. Please send us a copy of the fee reduction voucher you received from ETS for the GRE test.
How to utilize this waiver:
If you believe you might be eligible for a financial need-based application fee waiver based on the criteria above, please contact the Financial Aid office at finaidse@uccs.edu and supply the necessary documentation listed above.
If approved for a fee waiver, the UCCS Financial Aid Office will work with Graduate Admissions to waive your app fee.
Military and Veteran Application Fee Options:
Upon selecting one of the following four options as your US Military Status within the graduate application, you will not have to pay the application fee. UCCS thanks you for your service!
Active Duty
Reserve
National Guard
Veteran
How to utilize this waiver:
Your application fee will be waived automatically. If you see your application is asking for payment, please email gograd@uccs.edu for assistance.
Submitting Transcripts
Submitting transcripts for application review:
Applicants applying as degree-seeking may submit official or unofficial transcripts from ALL previously attended institutions for admission application review. Applications missing transcripts will not be reviewed or completed.
Screenshots of unofficial transcripts will not be accepted. Grade reports (which may include individual semester grade reports from student portals) will not be accepted in place of unofficial transcripts.
Applicants who have previously attended UCCS or another University of Colorado campus:
Applicants who have previously attended UCCS or another University of Colorado campus (Boulder, Denver or Anschutz) do NOT need to submit official transcripts if all coursework was take AFTER 1988. If an applicant attended one of these campuses prior to 1988, please reach out to each campus individually to order/request transcripts to be sent to UCCS, as these are not digitally maintained.
If a student is admitted:
Final official transcripts for ALL colleges previously attended are required for enrollment, regardless of the number of credit hours/degree conferral. Official transcripts should include the institution’s seal, date, and the Registrar’s signature.
UCCS accepts official transcripts via three delivery methods, which can be found here:
Electronically: Official transcripts can be emailed from the institution to ugapp@uccs.edu. Institutions using the National Student Clearinghouse or Parchment will have the most up to date information for UCCS transcript delivery in their systems. Please ensure official transcripts are being sent to ugapp@uccs.edu.
In-Person Hard Copy: If a student is choosing to bring a hard copy transcript to the UCCS Admissions Office, the transcripts should be presented in a sealed, unopened institution branded envelope. Opened copies of transcripts will be considered unofficial.
Postal/Mail Service: Official transcripts being mailed should be provided in a sealed, branded envelope addressed from the sender. Transcripts can be mailed to:
UCCS Office of Admissions
1420 Austin Bluffs Parkway
Colorado Springs, CO 80918-3733
Entrance Exams
Each program has their own criteria for admission requirements, including Entrance Exams. Some programs may require the GRE (Graduate Record Examinations), GMAT (Graduate Management Admissions Test), MAT (Miller Analogies Test), LSAT (Law School Admissions Test) or the MCAT (Medical College Admissions Test). You can view the admission requirements for each program, including any necessary Entrance Exam information on our Graduate Programs page.
Be sure to check your admission requirements early! It often can take a while to receive your scores.
For the GRE only:
To send your scores directly from the testing site to UCCS, use the code 4874.

Accelerated Masters Pathway (AMP)
The Accelerated Master’s Pathway (previously known as "Accelerated Master's Program"), otherwise known as “AMP” allows high achieving students, currently enrolled at UCCS, the opportunity to pursue existing Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in an accelerated manner for participating UCCS graduate programs.
AMP allows students to take graduate level courses, which will count towards graduation requirements for both their Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees.
If you are a currently enrolled UCCS undergraduate student, please visit our Accelerated Master’s Pathway page to learn more about participating graduate programs, criteria for admission and the application process.
Streamlined Application
The Streamlined Application is designed to offer outstanding UCCS students and alumni an expedited application to graduate school in participating programs.
If you are interested in applying, please fill out the regular application and submit all required documents needed for the Streamlined application. Once you select that you have previously attended UCCS, it will ask you if you will be submitting a streamlined application.
For more information on our Streamlined Applications for outstanding UCCS students and alumni, please visit our Streamlined Application page

Common Issues with the Admissions Application:
Incorrect Admission Term Error:
If you are experiencing issues on your admission application regarding selecting the correct term on the Enrollment Information screen in your admissions portal, please review the following important information.
Important: Multiple programs at UCCS utilize a cohort model and only admit students for one semester throughout the year. Please review our Graduate Programs page to view a full list of start terms for your desired graduate program to ensure you are selecting the correct application cycle: https://graduateschool.uccs.edu/academics
Select the appropriate application cycle:
For Fall 2026, Spring 2027, and Summer 2027 start terms, select: 2026-2027.
For Fall 2027, Spring 2028, and Summer 2028 start terms, select: 2027-2028
Two options for correcting your application:
Option #1:
Go to: uccs.edu/apply
In the “Select Application” dropdown box, select “Graduate”
In the “Select Term” dropdown box, select your desired term. Please be sure that your program admits students for this semester. Review our website for more information and admissible terms: https://graduateschool.uccs.edu/academics
Select the appropriate application cycle:
For Fall 2026, Spring 2027, and Summer 2027 start terms, select: 2026-2027.
For Fall 2027, Spring 2028, and Summer 2028 start terms, select: 2027-2028.
Option #2:
Log into your Application Portal.
Select “Start New Application” towards the bottom of the screen.
Select the appropriate application cycle:
For Fall 2026, Spring 2027, and Summer 2027 start terms, select: 2026-2027.
For Fall 2027, Spring 2028, and Summer 2028 start terms, select: 2027-2028.
